title: A squared Pólya–Szegö and Diaz–Metcalf inequality for positive linear maps
statement:
Let $\Phi$ be a unital positive linear map, and let $A$ and $B$ be positive operators satisfying

$$
0<m_{1}^{2}\leq A\leq M_{1}^{2},
$$

and

$$
0<m_{2}^{2}\leq B\leq M_{2}^{2},
$$

for positive real numbers $m_{1}\leq M_{1}$ and $m_{2}\leq M_{2}$. Write $A\sharp B$ for the operator geometric mean. **Squared Pólya–Szegö and Diaz–Metcalf inequalities.** The inequalities

$$
(\Phi(A)\sharp\Phi(B))^2\leq\frac{1}{4}\left(\sqrt{\frac{M_1M_2}{m_1m_2}}+\sqrt{\frac{m_1m_2}{M_1M_2}}\right)^2\Phi(A\sharp B)^2
$$

and

$$
\left(\frac{M_2m_2}{M_1m_1}\Phi(A)+\Phi(B)\right)^2\leq\left(\frac{M_2}{m_1}+\frac{m_2}{M_1}\right)^2\Phi(A\sharp B)^2
$$

should hold. These inequalities refine operator versions of the Pólya–Szegö and Diaz–Metcalf inequalities by relating the geometric mean of the images, and a weighted sum of the images, to the image of the geometric mean. The supplied text does not give resolution evidence beyond presenting the result as a conjecture, so its status is left open.
references:
Source: https://arxiv.org/abs/1501.02939

Status: no resolution is reported in the source (as of January 2015).
source_name: Mohammad Sal Moslehian and Xiaohui Fu, “Squaring operator Pólya–Szegö and Diaz–Metcalf type inequalities”, arXiv:1501.02939 (2015).
